intent: Five independent new horn-focused asymmetric noble blue moon bows with two actual design references

images.name: 월익 삼지궁
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW elegant legendary fantasy longbow of the "Twilight of the Blue Moon" family. Both supplied images are DESIGN REFERENCES ONLY, NOT editing targets and NOT images to show inside the result. Reference 1 is A04, with softly branching moon horns; reference 2 is V01, with a sweeping wide crystal horn. Use their noble luminous blue moonstone material, fine gold edging, open curves and dramatic structural asymmetry. This time the sculptural HORNS ARE THE MAIN SUBJECT OF THE BOW'S DESIGN. The blue limbs themselves grow into gracefully branching, curving, subtly twisting CRYSTAL LUNAR ANTLERS, with polished slender tapering three-dimensional tines like an otherworldly royal reindeer's antlers sculpted from luminous cobalt and sapphire moonlit glass. No brown horn, bone, wood, opaque steel, grey metal or blue-painted iron. Deep noble blue is the dominant body material. Hair-thin restrained gold filigree follows only some edges. Moon symbolism comes mainly from crescent-shaped NEGATIVE SPACES between curved horns; at most ONE SMALL luminous crescent gemstone near the grip. NO stack of large filled crescent-moon plates. Curves must flow continuously from the functional bow body: no randomly pasted blades, floating antlers or excessive clutter. Clearly different upper and lower limb lengths, volumes, curves and decoration; never mirror upper and lower halves.

Composition: exactly ONE complete longbow upright, single near-front view with a slight three-quarter depth, on a clean uniform near-black midnight navy background. Portrait image, 1024 by 1536 pixels. Allow a generous uniform EMPTY BORDER of AT LEAST 7% on ALL sides: top tip must be at or below y=110; bottom tip at or above y=1425; all side horns stay inside x=75 to x=949. Scale the entire weapon to only 84-85% of canvas height, not edge-to-edge. Show the entire upper and lower tips, ALL horn tips, clear usable wrapped grip and ONE fine taut bowstring on the RIGHT visibly connected to both tips. The real functional bow curvature must stay legible. Crisp refined fantasy concept-art craft, deep cobalt body with translucent pale-blue horn edges and internal moonlight; restrained glow that does not obscure the silhouette. No people, hands, arrows, other weapons, second bow, multiple views, collage, inset, text, label or watermark.

Specific design for this new single bow:
An upper-heavy winglike antler bow. Above a slightly low grip, the outer LEFT upper limb unfurls into THREE sweeping long crystal horns branching from one coherent blue root, spreading widely sideways left at three UNEQUAL heights and lengths, almost like a wing but unmistakably smooth antler tines, NOT feather plates. The top tine is longest and nearly horizontal before curling upward; the middle tine sweeps diagonally left-up; the lowest is shorter, slender and hooks softly inward. Their irregular airy gaps describe a crescent without a filled moon plate. The upper main recurve still reaches a separate clear string tip; the lower limb is shorter, narrow and simple with a clean elegant inward recurve and no antler cluster. One tiny blue crescent gem may sit just above the grip. Wide, open, gracefully branching silhouette.

visual_qa.inspected_with: view_image on each saved original PNG
visual_qa.framing_note: 상하 여백은 육안상 약 3~6%로 요청한 7%보다 좁지만 모든 활 끝과 뿔 끝이 온전히 들어 있다. 생성 원본 바이트를 유지했다.
visual_qa.design_notes: 상단 바깥쪽으로 길이가 다른 세 갈래 주된 월뿔이 넓게 뻗는다. 두꺼운 푸른 주줄기와 열린 초승 공간, 짧고 단순한 하단의 대비가 분명하다.

An asymmetrical bow organized around TWO STAGGERED, OFFSET blue antler horns above the grip. One long horn originates higher on the main upper limb and sweeps left and downward before turning up; a smaller second horn originates lower, crosses BEHIND the first in perspective, then curls left and up at a different angle. Their offset smooth curves frame one large airy CRESCENT-SHAPED NEGATIVE SPACE through which the dark background is plainly visible. The main upper recurve remains taller, while the lower limb has a broader short wave root then an unusually fine long taper. Readable layered depth at the crossing, sculptural rounded crystal horns, a little torsion, brilliant blue edge highlights, fine gold tracery. Not a symmetrical ring.
